menu.discussion1Text: I was playing the Nuka World DLC and ended up in the kiddie kingdom — everything was fine until I reached Oswald in the theater. It stayed fine until I died, which kicked off Oswald's quests, and I finished the Fun House, but when I went back to the theater, Oswald's cutscene started playing again, and now I can't kill him or restart the quest. Should I just reload an earlier save and start over?
menu.discussion2Text: Which one did you like more? Which game do you think is better?
menu.guide1Title: Fallout 4: How to get the X-01 power armor
menu.guide1Text: In this guide I'll show you how to get a full set of X-01 power armor — it's fairly easy, and it's the toughest power armor in the game.
menu.guide2Title: Skyrim Requiem buffs and debuffs guide
menu.guide2Text: This is a beginner's guide to Requiem, written by a fellow beginner, to make build choices easier.
menu.review1Text: Sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, you'll end up in a hell full of cannibals. Craft, build, and fight to survive, alone or with friends, in this terrifying new open-world survival simulator.
menu.review2Text: Step into the role of a monster slayer and set out on the path: from role-playing adventures to card-game duels. Leave your mark on the world of "The Witcher".
menu.comment1: This is incredible! Thanks for such useful content! It's always interesting to read your posts, since they're always packed with useful information and new ideas. Keep it up!

refund.intro: We strive to provide our customers with the best products and services. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, please review our refund policy to understand how you can get a refund.

s1.title: 1. General provisions
s1.p1: 1.1. This Refund Policy governs the process of returns and refunds for purchases made at our game store (hereinafter — "Store").
s1.p2: 1.2. This Policy applies to all Store customers.

s2.title: 2. Returning products
s2.p1: 2.1. You may return physical items purchased at the Store within [30] days of the purchase date, provided the items are in their original packaging and have not been used.
s2.p2: 2.2. For digital items (such as game keys, digital downloads), returns and refunds are only possible if the item has not been activated or downloaded.

s3.title: 3. Return procedure
s3.p1: 3.1. To initiate a return, contact our customer support team via [specify contact method: email, phone, website form].
s3.p2: 3.2. Once we receive your request, we will provide you with instructions for returning the item.
s3.p3: 3.3. You are responsible for return shipping costs unless otherwise stated in our Policy.

s4.title: 4. Processing returns
s4.p1: 4.1. Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will send you a notification about the status of your return.
s4.p2: 4.2. If the return is approved, we will process your refund within [10] business days. The refund will be issued using the same method used for the original payment.

s5.title: 5. Refunds
s5.p1: 5.1. We will refund the full price of the item, excluding shipping costs, unless the item was defective.
s5.p2: 5.2. If the item is returned due to a defect or an error on our part, we will also refund the shipping costs.

s6.title: 6. Exclusions
s6.p1: 6.1. Some items are not eligible for return, including but not limited to the following:
items: Items showing clear signs of use or damage caused by the customer.

s7.title: 7. Exchanging items
s7.p1: 7.1. We offer item exchanges only if the item turns out to be defective or was sent in error. To arrange an exchange, contact our customer support team.

s8.title: 8. Contact
s8.p1: 8.1. If you have any questions or comments regarding this Refund Policy, please contact us using the contact information provided on our site.
